choices.change: A killing blow on an enemy that yields experience gives you 20 Energy.

choices.name: Fatal Edge
choices.description: Finishing move: Physical damage that grows with each combo point. It deals 50% more to a target under 35% health.
choices.change: Deals 50% more to a target under 35% health.

choices.name: Deep Backstab
choices.description: A 40-Energy combo point builder from behind the target: 180% weapon damage plus a bonus, and 1 combo point.
choices.change: Deals 180% weapon damage instead of 150%.

choices.name: Cruel Backstab
choices.description: A 40-Energy combo point builder from behind the target: 150% weapon damage plus a bonus, and 1 combo point. Its critical strikes deal 30% more.
choices.change: Its critical strikes deal 30% more.

choices.name: Swift Backstab
choices.description: A 30-Energy combo point builder from behind the target: 150% weapon damage plus a bonus, and 1 combo point.
choices.change: Costs 30 Energy instead of 40.

choices.name: Quick Shadows
choices.description: Out of combat only. Mobs ignore you unless very close; your first attack from stealth is a critical strike and breaks it. Cooldown 4 sec.
choices.change: Its cooldown is 4 sec instead of 9 sec.

choices.name: Shadow Speed
choices.description: Out of combat only. Mobs ignore you unless very close; your first attack from stealth is a critical strike and breaks it. You run 30% faster while stealthed.
choices.change: You run 30% faster while stealthed.

choices.name: Stalker
choices.description: Out of combat only. Mobs ignore you unless very close; your first attack from stealth is a critical strike and breaks it. Your first Backstab out of Stealth costs nothing.
choices.change: Your first Backstab out of Stealth costs no Energy.

choices.name: Brutal Ambush
choices.description: From Stealth and from behind the target: 300% weapon damage plus a bonus, and 2 combo points.
choices.change: Deals 300% weapon damage instead of 250%.

choices.name: Ambush and Run
choices.description: From Stealth and from behind the target: 250% weapon damage plus a bonus, and 3 combo points.
choices.change: Awards 3 combo points instead of 2.

choices.name: Lingering Ambush
choices.description: From Stealth and from behind the target: 250% weapon damage plus a bonus, and 2 combo points. The target also bleeds every 3 sec for 9 sec.
choices.change: The target also bleeds for 9 sec.

choices.name: Shadow Dance
choices.description: Vanish's cooldown is 40 sec shorter.

choices.name: Assassin's Mark
choices.description: Ambush and Backstab are 10% more likely to be critical strikes.

choices.name: Quick Recovery
choices.description: Each finishing move gives you back 15 Energy.

choices.name: Fleeting Vanish
choices.description: Every enemy forgets you: you leave combat and slip into Stealth. You also run 40% faster for 4 sec.
choices.change: You also run 40% faster for 4 sec.

choices.name: Ready Vanish
choices.description: Every enemy forgets you: you leave combat and slip into Stealth. It also finishes the cooldowns of Kidney Shot and Cold Blood.
choices.change: Also finishes the cooldowns of Kidney Shot and Cold Blood.

choices.name: Shadow Heal
choices.description: Every enemy forgets you: you leave combat and slip into Stealth. It also heals you.

choices.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 5.5 seconds. When it stops a cast, you gain 1 combo point. It does not break Stealth.
choices.change: Does not break Stealth.

choices.name: Double Kick
choices.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 5.5 seconds. When it stops a cast, you gain 2 combo points.
choices.change: A stopped cast gives 2 combo points instead of 1.

choices.name: Second Wind
choices.description: Your next skill hit within 20 sec is a sure critical strike. It also gives you 30 Energy.
choices.change: Also gives you {amount:30:0:0:0} Energy.

choices.name: Quick Blood
choices.description: Your next skill hit within 20 sec is a sure critical strike. Cooldown 40 sec.
choices.change: Its cooldown is 40 sec instead of 60 sec.

choices.name: Two Charges
choices.description: Your next two skill hits within 20 sec are sure critical strikes.
choices.change: Lasts 2 skill hits instead of 1.

choices.description: Finishing move: stuns the target for 1 sec per combo point. Cooldown 15 sec.

choices.name: Executioner
